rule_A: MS §4.4: five epistemic statuses conceptually projected / documented / legal constitution evidenced / material establishment evidenced / exercise evidenced
rule_B: ON §4: claim statuses conceptually_projected / documented / legally_constituted / materially_instantiated / operationally_observed
documented_precedence: MS (v0.6.1) prevails over ON; AP discrepancy #2 adopts the two-axis model
execution_decision: Use the MS vocabulary with the token forms of the template §12 (legal_constitution_evidenced, material_establishment_evidenced, exercise_evidenced). ON names are not used; mapping: legally_constituted->legal_constitution_evidenced; materially_instantiated->material_establishment_evidenced; operationally_observed->exercise_evidenced
justification: MS is Level 1; AP records the same precedence

rule_A: MS §4.3 (N1-N4): a norm that only obliges establishment (N2) constitutes the obligation, not the entity
rule_B: ON stress case M04 / §3.2 / glance: a mandated unbuilt platform is `legally_constituted` as a device
documented_precedence: MS prevails; AP discrepancy #1 and IR 'frozen ontology divergences'
execution_decision: Classify every establishment-related provision as N1-N4 by wording; an entity is legally constituted only under N1; the M04 expected result is NOT applied; the baseline note remains pending Igor's decision
justification: ON itself carries PT-1/X01 (constitution by mandate) consistent with MS; M04 predates it

rule_A: MS §4.4: legal status of the norm (in force / not yet applicable / suspended / expired or repealed / conditional on further act) separate from epistemic status of the claim
rule_B: ON §3.3: relation field status in {established, conditional, expressly prohibited} overlapping condition and modality
execution_decision: Every record carries modality, conditions, legal_status_of_norm, epistemic_status and derivation as separate fields; the ON `status` field is not used; prohibitions are recorded as modality/constraint (see C-08)
justification: avoids redundancy and avoids treating 'documented' as a legal status

rule_A: MS §6.2-6.3: instrument is a typed characteristic OR a juridically constituted device; establishment is an evidenced STATUS; I1-I4 = S->A warrant conditions
rule_B: ON §3.2: three instrument situations labelled I1/I2/I3
documented_precedence: MS prevails; AP states the label collision and the operative notation
execution_decision: Instrument treatments are written INS-TYPE and DEV; establishment status MEST (always not_assessed here); the labels I1-I3 of ON are never used; I1-I4 mean only the S->A conditions
justification: AP discrepancy #3; label collision documented in AP preamble

rule_A: MS §5.2, §6.1: an interface is a legally constituted transition between positions, only sometimes mediated by a separate device
rule_B: ON glance/notes: interfaces described mainly through devices
execution_decision: Transitions are recorded as relations by default; a DEV is recorded only where the text gives identity and operator/rules/bounded function; arguable cases INS-TYPE + queue (HQ-DEV)
justification: prevents inflating devices

rule_A: MS §2.4: W (documentary corpus) is distinct from A1...Am (reconstructed); an instrument may yield none, one or several
rule_B: ON §2/§3.5: the whole A is the architecture of an explicitly bounded corpus (boundary conflated with architecture)
execution_decision: W declared separately; A named only after I1-I4; the default status of every candidate grouping is S
justification: required by MS and by the experimental directive (W != A)

rule_A: MS §6.2: S->A requires I1-I4, connection != integration
rule_B: ON: no S->A protocol (only stopping, closure and external-reference rules)
execution_decision: Apply I1-I4 in the anti-circularity sequence; no scores or thresholds; I2/I3 thresholds are the main subject of human adjudication
justification: additive; thresholds unvalidated -> every INTEGRATED/OVERLAPPING outcome is queued

rule_A: MS §6.2: a prohibition is a norm about a relation or action, not a connection that exists; recorded as a constraint on the positions concerned
rule_B: ON §3.3: modality includes prohibition and relation status 'expressly prohibited'; DR §4.3: a QR whenever both parties are identifiable
documented_precedence: MS prevails; AP table row 2: prohibitions recorded as modality, not as existing links
execution_decision: Prohibitions recorded as NORMATIVE_ASSIGNMENTS with modality=prohibition and constraint_only=Y (counterpart filled if identifiable); not admitted to QUALIFIED_RELATIONS
justification: keeps the relation set limited to constituted connections

rule_A: MS §6.4: three substantive types (information / answerability / accountability) and a separate evidential sufficiency (sufficient / indeterminate); 'accountability asserted without forum, duty or channel is not a fourth type'
rule_B: ON §3.3.1 (D10): four classes INFO / ANSWERABILITY / AC / IND
execution_decision: Three types plus accountability_sufficiency in {sufficient, indeterminate}; the ON class IND maps to sufficiency=indeterminate with the missing elements recorded
justification: same content, different bookkeeping; MS is controlling

rule_A: MS: 'undetermined' for S->A and absence-dependent claims
rule_B: DR §15: outcome 'indeterminate'; user directive: INDETERMINATE
documented_precedence: no conflict of substance; token only
execution_decision: `undetermined` for properties/absence claims; `INDETERMINATE` for S->A and instrument-level outcomes (equivalent meaning)
justification: preserves both sources' terms

rule_A: MS §5.3 condition 1: transfer structure, not measures; no indices computed on spatial graphs; any measure on legal relations needs separate justification
rule_B: ON §6 table lists 'centrality' among positional property examples
execution_decision: No centrality or other graph index is computed; positional properties are stated qualitatively with explicit path semantics
justification: MS is Level 1

rule_A: MS §6.5 / ON §3.7: external references include 'another part of the same instrument'
rule_B: MS §8.4(2): W is the complete instrument and every operative provision is covered
execution_decision: Because W is the complete instrument, intra-instrument cross-references resolve within W (supporting units and derivation); EXT is reserved for sources outside W; ambiguous cases are queued (HQ-XREF)
justification: wrapper decision GAP-03; to be confirmed by Igor

rule_A: START_HERE_V0_6 names MANUSCRIPT_v0_6.md as the canonical manuscript
rule_B: AP: MANUSCRIPT_v0_6_1.md takes provisional precedence (Igor, 2026-10-03); RR: v0.6 -> v0.6.1 revision; user directive: v0.6.1 controlling

rule_B: DR §7: 'cooperation' is not one of the ten types; coded as information/reporting or representation/participation with type_note and flag
documented_precedence: ON and DR are consistent in the type list
execution_decision: Ten types only; content fitting none is coded to the nearest type with type_note and a flag; no new type
justification: template rule consistent with ON

rule_A: DR §6 function vocabulary and residual tags (generic)
rule_B: no authorized RGAM source states the function vocabulary (the template cites a source outside the authorized set)

rule_A: ON §3.3: direction (if defensible) and parties with roles
rule_B: DR v1.1-1.2: origin = legal subject (obligor); counterpart = right-holder/addressee; governance direction in type_note

justification: template consistent with ON

rule_A: DR §17: seeded draw with a seed derived from an instrument-specific file; trace choice by fixed rule
rule_B: case-independence requires no instrument-specific content
execution_decision: Generalized: seed = integer of first 8 hex digits of the case's own source SHA-256; plus largest-support rule
justification: procedure retained, instrument-specific seed removed

rule_A: DR §2: instrument-specific text baseline with a corrigendum applied
rule_B: protocol must be case-general
execution_decision: Removed; replaced by capsule corpus declaration and DR-03/DR-04

rule_A: DR §1: architectural inference ids 'AI-nn'
rule_B: an instrument name in the experiment collides with the prefix

rule_A: MS §6.2: D (derived analytic dimensions: strategies, logics) is separate from X (adjacent empirical layers)
rule_B: ON §2: strategies and logics placed in X
execution_decision: D and X are both not coded; strategies and logics are not derived in this execution

rule_A: ON §6.1: ten architectural dimensions with bearers and families (RGAM proposal)
rule_B: ON §6.1 last paragraph: a separate list of twelve candidate measures exists; the two lists are not harmonised (decision for David)

rule_A: Open thresholds: the device threshold (identity + operator/rules/function); I2/I3 integration thresholds; the 'grounded possibility of consequences' element of accountability
rule_B: none (acknowledged limitations MS §8.2)
execution_decision: Applied as stated; every borderline or integrative judgment is queued for human adjudication (HQ-DEV, HQ-ACCOUNT, HQ-INTEGRATION, HQ-OVERLAP)

rule_A: ON §11: a rule for reading drafting cues ('is established' vs 'shall be established') in translated texts remains open; MS §4.3: cues must be checked on the authentic text
rule_B: capsules supply the English official text
execution_decision: Classify on the English text supplied; ambiguous or compound wording is recorded as such and queued (HQ-NORMTYPE); no cue is inferred
justification: stated limitation

rule_A: ON §3.1: a position is a legally specified place in at least one qualified relation
rule_B: MS §6.2: normative assignments attach to positions without a counterparty (e.g., duties of a category of persons)
execution_decision: A position is admitted if it bears at least one NA or QR; an actor with no NA/QR is not a position
justification: MS §6.2 normative-assignment rule
